decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 25/04/05 it could not be established that the limitation period for the taking of enforcement action had expired, therefore the use of the subject premises as outlined in the application is considered to be unlawful under Section 191 (2) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1995.

Condition : 2 - Informative:

If a further application is made more evidence must be submitted that shows the house has been in a continued use as two separate flats since June 2001, which would include the following:

?	Tenancy agreements for the last four years.
?	Evidence that both flats have separate utilities for at least the last 4 years e.g. BT and Gas bills and evidence as to when these separate utilities were installed.
?	A sworn statement from someone who has personal knowledge of the premises for more than 4 years and setting out the history of the conversation.
?	Letters from former tenants and/or neighbours confirming conversion more than 4 years ago.
?	Statement from Ashdale Management who have been managing one of the flats since October 2001.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the continued use of premises as 2 self contained flats.
